owns: Owner-directed card backfill repair (2026-10-04): revolving-card minimum rules below retain payment-movement aliases and lookup windows only. provider-observe.cardMinimumNeedsConfirmation refuses automatic settlement for these obligations, including pending replacements. Payee, mapped card, posting date, amount, categories, notes and tags do not establish minimum-payment intent. Exact occurrence confirmations already in plan.opening.representedEvents remain authoritative; this neither asserts an unpaid lender minimum nor adds an obligation. Unambiguous provider-transaction to Forecast-event identity. A match requires an explicit payee alias + mapped Atlas account + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for the named fixed Tennis BC salary streams only — a uniquely proven transfer credit into BILLS (chequing-a) that is independently paired to the TENNIS INCOME salary flow + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for named youtube-premium, named spotify, named chatgpt-plus-dale, named chatgpt-plus-amanda, and named icloud-storage — schedule-trust-on-due, which represents the occurrence from the schedule itself on or after the due date without a bank transaction. Optional payeeExcludePatterns refuse a hit that also matches a reimbursement or other excluded alias. Same-day is the default; named automatic payments may opt into weekend-to-next-business-day; the legacy mapped-card lookup relation identifies the latest due on or before posting, without proving minimum intent. A covers-due-on-or-before-posting match against a once occurrence is allowed only when the posting is on or before seven calendar days after that due; a later same-alias debit does not reuse that once occurrence. Named Fortis, Shaw, Netflix, heloc, bell-sep15-2026, and bell may use covers-early-or-due-on-or-before-posting: after identity, a debit may settle the nearest due within seven calendar days after posting (early pay) or the latest due on or before posting. A nearer prior due still wins over a farther upcoming due when distances tie. Named Triangle and MBNA card-minimum rules may instead use covers-statement-cycle-or-latest-due: the legacy lookup window includes the upcoming minimum created by that card's debts.statementCloseDay and the latest due on or before posting, but these dates do not establish minimum intent. Statement close days are not copied into this file. Amount similarity is not identity. The legacy amount-at-least card rule is not sufficient to settle a minimum; automatic card-minimum settlement is withheld regardless of amount. Named tdfees uses two-leg-sum: both named MONTHLY ACCOUNT FEE debit legs (chequing-a and chequing-b) must uniquely match the same occurrence before it is represented. One leg is not settlement. Two same-account legs are not that tdfees settlement. Named bell-sep15-2026 opts into same-account split legs on two-leg-sum (sameAccountSplitLegs true): exactly two distinct posted Bell Mobility / BELLMOBILITY debits on canonical chequing-a, the same household posting date, and early-or-due, both resolving only to that once occurrence. Named standing bell, from firstDue 2026-10-15, opts into that same same-account split on a separate chequing-a rule. The standing Travel Visa single-debit rule remains. A two-leg subset that is not an accepted pair does not veto that Travel Visa debit. An accepted BILLS pair and a Travel Visa debit for the same standing occurrence stay unresolved. One payment's transaction ids cannot settle both bell-sep15-2026 and a standing bell occurrence. Same-account combining is not the default. Two same-account legs without that explicit opt-in are not settlement. The observed sum is settlement evidence after identity, not identity. Named fixed salary streams retain the legacy same-day exact scheduled amount guard when no independent payroll packet exists. A configured salaryReceiptPayeePatterns alias additionally permits one posted native CAD employer payroll credit on the mapped TENNIS INCOME external account, uniquely linked by exact observed amount to a posted CAD debit on that same account and its paired BILLS transfer credit. Exactly one named salary occurrence must lie between source receipt and transfer, within a complete bounded fetch. The source receipt amount is actual; it need not equal plan. Two sources, transfers, counterparts or occurrences stay ambiguous. Coaching, reimbursements, unmatched transfers, pending and foreign units cannot earn this packet. Source and transfer are one income receipt, not two. A generic exact-amount BILLS transfer is not salary identity. A TENNIS BC payee credit on a household account is not salary identity. A TENNIS INCOME deposit or reimbursement is not household-cash posting proof. An unrelated household transfer is not salary identity. A refund or merchant credit is not a card-minimum payment. The mapped TD personal, Cash Back, and Travel Visa posted credit alias PAYMENT - THANK YOU is a card-payment movement alias; a payee that also matches a refund or reversal alias is not. A payment before statement creation does not settle that future minimum. Named mapped-MBNA card-credit rules that claim the literal payee payment require payeeMatchMode exact; a PAYMENT-prefixed reversal, refund, or protection alias is not that identity. Fortis, Shaw, Netflix, tdfees, bell-sep15-2026, and bell remain identity-plus-evidence each cycle: matching confirmed-settled transactions create representedActuals and mark PAID; without matching evidence those bills stay still-due / unverified. YouTube Premium, Spotify, ChatGPT Plus Dale, ChatGPT Plus Amanda, and iCloud Storage are the named schedule-trust exceptions. Do not settle chatgpt-plus-amanda from the Dale rule. Do not invent an Apple scrape or Gmail fetch. Named amazon-prime is the exact payee aliases Amazon Prime and Amazon.ca Prime, mapped Travel Visa, debit, and same-day posting. The exact scheduled amount is a necessary guard after that identity, not identity by itself. Ordinary Amazon shopping, Amazon Prime Video, another card, another day, and a different Prime-like amount do not settle it. Do not use schedule-trust for amazon-prime. Named phoenix-digital-health is the owner-confirmed (2026-10-06) monthly Amanda Phoenix Digital Health card charge: exact payee Phoenix Digital Health or Phoenix Digital Corp, mapped Travel Visa, debit, covers-early-or-due-on-or-before-posting with earlyPayLookaheadDays 2, and the exact scheduled $174.99 as a necessary guard after identity. The $1.00 authorization pair, pending, another amount, and another card do not settle it. A Bills to Travel Visa transfer is card backfill, not this expense. Named warriors is the once Logan Warriors Elite Academy U13 commitment: exact payee Vancouver Warriors, mapped Travel Visa, debit, and covers-early-or-due-on-or-before-posting with earlyPayLookaheadDays 2 so the 2026-09-21 posting can settle the 2026-09-23 due. The exact scheduled $895 is a necessary guard after that identity, not identity by itself. The 2026-08-11 Vancouver Warriors $40 charge, another amount, another account, another merchant, and a posting more than two days before the due are not this settlement. A once occurrence is not reused more than seven days after its due. Two compatible charges stay unresolved. A savings transfer or a Travel Visa payment is not this expense and is not income. Do not invent a prior-period versus current-period surplus split.
